<h4 id="websecuritytemplatesecuritypolicybotmanagementbasicbotsettingsbotintelligencebotratingslikelybotrequestsaction">
Web<wbr>Security<wbr>Template<wbr>Security<wbr>Policy<wbr>Bot<wbr>Management<wbr>Basic<wbr>Bot<wbr>Settings<wbr>Bot<wbr>Intelligence<wbr>Bot<wbr>Ratings<wbr>Likely<wbr>Bot<wbr>Requests<wbr>Action<pulumi-choosable type="language" values="python,go" class="inline">, Web<wbr>Security<wbr>Template<wbr>Security<wbr>Policy<wbr>Bot<wbr>Management<wbr>Basic<wbr>Bot<wbr>Settings<wbr>Bot<wbr>Intelligence<wbr>Bot<wbr>Ratings<wbr>Likely<wbr>Bot<wbr>Requests<wbr>Action<wbr>Args</pulumi-choosable>
</h4>

<div>
<pulumi-choosable type="language" values="csharp">
<dl class="resources-properties"><dt class="property-required"
            title="Required">
        <span id="name_csharp">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#name_csharp" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">Name</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">string</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Specifies the specific actions for safe execution. valid values:. - Deny. specifies to block requests from accessing site resources. - Monitor: observation, only record logs. - Redirect: Redirect to URL. - Disabled: specifies that the rule is not enabled. - Allow: specifies whether to allow access with delayed processing of requests. - Challenge: specifies the challenge content to respond to. - Trans: pass and allow requests to directly access site resources. - BlockIP: to be deprecated. ip block. - ReturnCustomPage: to be deprecated. use specified page for interception. - JSChallenge: to be deprecated, JavaScript challenge;. - ManagedChallenge: to be deprecated. managed challenge.</dd><dt class="property-optional"

<h4 id="websecuritytemplatesecuritypolicybotmanagementbasicbotsettingsipreputationipreputationgroupbaseaction">
Web<wbr>Security<wbr>Template<wbr>Security<wbr>Policy<wbr>Bot<wbr>Management<wbr>Basic<wbr>Bot<wbr>Settings<wbr>Ip<wbr>Reputation<wbr>Ip<wbr>Reputation<wbr>Group<wbr>Base<wbr>Action<pulumi-choosable type="language" values="python,go" class="inline">, Web<wbr>Security<wbr>Template<wbr>Security<wbr>Policy<wbr>Bot<wbr>Management<wbr>Basic<wbr>Bot<wbr>Settings<wbr>Ip<wbr>Reputation<wbr>Ip<wbr>Reputation<wbr>Group<wbr>Base<wbr>Action<wbr>Args</pulumi-choosable>

<div>
<pulumi-choosable type="language" values="csharp">
<dl class="resources-properties"><dt class="property-required"
            title="Required">
        <span id="name_csharp">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#name_csharp" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">Name</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">string</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Specifies the specific actions for safe execution. valid values:. - Deny. specifies to block requests from accessing site resources. - Monitor: observation, only record logs. - Redirect: Redirect to URL. - Disabled: specifies that the rule is not enabled. - Allow: specifies whether to allow access with delayed processing of requests. - Challenge: specifies the challenge content to respond to. - Trans: pass and allow requests to directly access site resources. - BlockIP: to be deprecated. ip block. - ReturnCustomPage: to be deprecated. use specified page for interception. - JSChallenge: to be deprecated, JavaScript challenge;. - ManagedChallenge: to be deprecated. managed challenge.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="allowactionparameters_csharp">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#allowactionparameters_csharp" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">Allow<wbr>Action<wbr>Parameters</a>
</span>

        <span class="property-type"><a href="#websecuritytemplatesecuritypolicybotmanagementbasicbotsettingsipreputationipreputationgroupbaseactionallowactionparameters">Tencent<wbr>Cloud<wbr>IAC.<wbr>Pulumi<wbr>Package.<wbr>Tencentcloud.<wbr>Teo.<wbr>Inputs.<wbr>Web<wbr>Security<wbr>Template<wbr>Security<wbr>Policy<wbr>Bot<wbr>Management<wbr>Basic<wbr>Bot<wbr>Settings<wbr>Ip<wbr>Reputation<wbr>Ip<wbr>Reputation<wbr>Group<wbr>Base<wbr>Action<wbr>Allow<wbr>Action<wbr>Parameters</a></span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Additional parameters when Name is Allow.</dd><dt class="property-optional"

        <span id="blockipactionparameters_csharp">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#blockipactionparameters_csharp" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">Block<wbr>Ip<wbr>Action<wbr>Parameters</a>

    </dt>

    </dt>
    <dd>Handling method for medium-risk requests. SecurityAction Name parameter supports: - Deny: block; - Monitor: observe; - Redirect: Redirect; - Challenge: Challenge. default value is Monitor.</dd></dl>

Condition supports expression configuration syntax: -  write according to the matching conditional expression syntax of rules, with support for referencing key and value. -  supports in, like operators, and logical combination with and. For example: - ${key} in ['x-trace-id']: the parameter name equals x-trace-id. - ${key} in ['x-trace-id'] and ${value} like ['Bearer *']: the parameter name equals x-trace-id and the parameter value wildcard matches Bearer *.</dd><dt class="property-required"
            title="Required">

        <span class="property-type">string</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Specifies the specific actions for safe execution. valid values:. - Deny. specifies to block requests from accessing site resources. - Monitor: observation, only record logs. - Redirect: Redirect to URL. - Disabled: specifies that the rule is not enabled. - Allow: specifies whether to allow access with delayed processing of requests. - Challenge: specifies the challenge content to respond to. - Trans: pass and allow requests to directly access site resources. - BlockIP: to be deprecated. ip block. - ReturnCustomPage: to be deprecated. use specified page for interception. - JSChallenge: to be deprecated, JavaScript challenge;. - ManagedChallenge: to be deprecated. managed challenge.</dd><dt class="property-optional"

Web<wbr>Security<wbr>Template<wbr>Security<wbr>Policy<wbr>Managed<wbr>Rules<wbr>Frequent<wbr>Scanning<wbr>Protection<pulumi-choosable type="language" values="python,go" class="inline">, Web<wbr>Security<wbr>Template<wbr>Security<wbr>Policy<wbr>Managed<wbr>Rules<wbr>Frequent<wbr>Scanning<wbr>Protection<wbr>Args</pulumi-choosable>

<div>

        <span id="action_csharp">

</span>

        <span class="property-type"><a href="#websecuritytemplatesecuritypolicymanagedrulesfrequentscanningprotectionaction">Tencent<wbr>Cloud<wbr>IAC.<wbr>Pulumi<wbr>Package.<wbr>Tencentcloud.<wbr>Teo.<wbr>Inputs.<wbr>Web<wbr>Security<wbr>Template<wbr>Security<wbr>Policy<wbr>Managed<wbr>Rules<wbr>Frequent<wbr>Scanning<wbr>Protection<wbr>Action</a></span>
    </dt>
    <dd>The handling action for high-frequency scan protection. required when Enabled is on. valid values for SecurityAction Name: - Deny: block and respond with an interception page; - Monitor: observe without processing requests, log security events in logs; - JSChallenge: respond with a JavaScript challenge page.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="actionduration_csharp">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#actionduration_csharp" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">Action<wbr>Duration</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">string</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>This parameter specifies the duration of the handling Action set by the high frequency scan protection Action parameter. value range: 60 to 86400. measurement unit: seconds (s) only, for example 60s. this field is required when Enabled is on.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="blockthreshold_csharp">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#blockthreshold_csharp" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">Block<wbr>Threshold</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">int</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>This parameter specifies the threshold for high-frequency scan protection, which is the intercept count of managed rules set to interception within the time range set by CountingPeriod. value range: 1 to 4294967294, for example 100. when exceeding this statistical value, subsequent requests will trigger the handling Action set by Action. required when Enabled is on.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="countby_csharp">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#countby_csharp" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">Count<wbr>By</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">string</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>The match mode for request statistics. required when Enabled is on. valid values: - http.request.xff_header_ip: client ip (priority match xff header);- http.request.ip: client ip.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="countingperiod_csharp">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#countingperiod_csharp" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">Counting<wbr>Period</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">string</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>This parameter specifies the statistical time window for high-frequency scan protection, which is the time window for counting requests that hit managed rules configured as block. valid values: 5-1800. measurement unit: seconds (s) only, such as 5s. this field is required when Enabled is on.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="enabled_csharp">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#enabled_csharp" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">Enabled</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">string</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Whether the high-frequency scan protection rule is enabled. valid values: - on: enable. the high-frequency scan protection rule takes effect.- off: disable. the high-frequency scan protection rule does not take effect.</dd></dl>
</pulumi-choosable>
</div>

## Import



TEO web security template can be imported using the zoneId#templateId, e.g.

```sh
$ pulumi import tencentcloud:Teo/webSecurityTemplate:WebSecurityTemplate example zone-3fkff38fyw8s#temp-3u86ilp39yyn
```



To learn more about importing existing cloud resources, see [Importing resources](/docs/using-pulumi/adopting-pulumi/import/).
